intent: Stack consecutive bubbles from the same sender into one tightly spaced column.
typical_uses: Several turns in a row from one sender, without a Message row around each

dont_use_when.situation: Consecutive turns that each carry an avatar, a header or a footer

instead.target: MessageGroup, with one Message per turn

invariants.text: The group is a flex column that spaces its children var(--space-2) apart and lets each Bubble move itself to the end edge with its own `align`.

anti_patterns.dont: Put bubbles from more than one sender in one BubbleGroup
anti_patterns.do_instead: Start a new BubbleGroup at each change of sender

anti_patterns.dont: Set an alignment on the group to move all of its bubbles
anti_patterns.do_instead: Set `align` on each Bubble; the group has no alignment prop

good.title: Two consecutive turns from the current user

bad.title: Alignment set on the group
bad.why: BubbleGroup declares no `align` and its div surface has none, so TypeScript rejects it; alignment belongs on each Bubble, and this one keeps its default start alignment.
